technical.summary: Strong trend structure with bullish moving average alignment and Ichimoku confirmation, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 85, Stoch 89) and stochastic bearish cross create pullback risk; suitable for scaled entry or confirmation of reversal.

fundamental.summary: AEP shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 56 days present material timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (30 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity neutral with only small sales by junior members; insufficient news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (401.76), flat yield curve, imminent NFP event, and 56-day earnings window create a highly adverse macro backdrop for AEP trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Ichimoku cloud breakup, golden cross (SMA 9/21), and new 20-day high confirm trend structure with contrarian buy signal in fear-zone market conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 85, Stochastic 89 with bearish cross), zero fundamental support, crisis VIX backdrop, and imminent earnings in 56 days create unacceptable pullback and event risk.

decision.primary_risk: Crisis VIX (401.76) combined with 56-day earnings window and zero fundamental support creates unacceptable event and macro risk; overbought technicals likely to reverse on any negative catalyst.
